publication_qualification_scope: Scoped technical source eligibility for the explicitly declared observed Windows profile only. This does not authenticate the future final source commit, build, extraction, tag or assets and does not record publication or broad native/manual/human acceptance.

owner_decision.scope: The owner explicitly selected Windows as the primary technical publication profile for v4.0.0, limited to the actual observed environment and declared checks. All teaching and setup materials remain included. macOS remains unqualified; other unobserved platforms and external or human scopes remain explicitly bounded.
owner_decision.support_decision_basis: The selected Windows observations passed within their recorded scope. No failed Windows check is removed or relabelled; preceding failures and all historical receipts remain retained.

observed_environment.scope: These are actual observed versions, not a claim that every Windows, PowerShell, Node or browser version was tested.

source_reuse_binding.reuse_scope: Recorded results remain bound to their original tested copies. Their bounded teaching, setup, form and runtime observations may be reused only for identical unit and affected script bytes. Current metadata, prose, validators and publishing controls have separate source checks; they do not claim another 334-check browser execution.
source_reuse_binding.current_source_identity: The current complete source manifest and PACKAGE_ID are supplied in current-integrity. A manifest-covered record cannot repeat its own newly calculated PACKAGE_ID or future commit without circularity.

retained_limits.environment_interference: Known Kaspersky requests were blocked and narrowly classified. This is not acceptance of the complete security/browser environment.
retained_limits.native_print: Selected owner-saved native drafts exist. Headless PDF creation and the instrumented S11 print callback do not prove every native print dialogue or printer.
retained_limits.accessibility: Selected trusted browser keyboard events, responsive viewports and reduced-motion states only; no complete accessibility certification.
retained_limits.runtime: Finite taught example boundaries. No all-version or retained full-framework/application acceptance. Existing Windows accented-console transport limitation remains.
retained_limits.learner_evidence: Synthetic QA does not complete assessed student projects, genuine learner AI work, manual declarations or Moodle submissions.

macOS.scope: All macOS setup materials remain included. No macOS native execution or platform qualification is asserted.

Linux.scope: Existing Linux Node, shell, HTTP, SQLite and document-rendering observations retain their actual scope. No whole-platform Linux qualification follows.

other_Windows_architectures_and_versions.scope: The profile is limited to the observed x64 environment and named versions/checks.

native_Microsoft_Word.scope: Thirty optional references have Linux rendering QA over 187 pages with 38 presentation warnings. Native Word acceptance remains unexecuted.

live_Moodle.scope: No live institutional Assignment or submission receipt is asserted.

owner_pedagogic_acceptance.scope: The owner profile decision and source commit do not assert complete pedagogic acceptance.

final_bindings.required_process: After the owner creates the final source commit, the builder must authenticate an exact clean checkout and complete Git inventory before constructing assets. Deterministic build, fresh extraction, source/tag/archive/manifest/receipt binding and actual publication require separate real receipts; none is fabricated here.

broad_gate_scope: The ten historical broad gates remain pending and general NOT_FINAL/native_acceptance false are preserved. PASS_DECLARED_WINDOWS_PROFILE_WITH_LIMITS is a separate source-publication eligibility claim, not broad native/manual/human PASS.

frozen_RC1.assets: Four original assets are retained unchanged; this profile never replaces or retags RC1.
